ADDED i1: When two LineIterators share the same underlying Reader and one is closed via closeQuietly(), the other iterator's nextLine() should throw IllegalStateException
ADDED i2: Closing secondIterator closes the shared underlying Reader
ADDED i4: Calling nextLine() on an iterator over an empty reader should throw NoSuchElementException, since there are no lines available.
ADDED i5: hasNext() should return false consistently when the underlying reader is empty, whether called once or multiple times.
ADDED i6: hasNext() should return true when the reader contains content, and calling it multiple times should yield the same result (idempotent).
ADDED i7: next() should return the full line content when the reader contains a single line.
ADDED i8: remove() is not supported by LineIterator and should always throw UnsupportedOperationException regardless of iterator state.
